title: Set up Clinic Preferences
summary: General clinic rules that change how other screens work.

steps.title: Menu → Business Setup → Clinic Preferences
steps.details: General clinic rules that change how other screens work.

steps.title: Discounts
steps.details: Enables discounts on quotes and invoices, capped by percentage or amount.

steps.title: ID document
steps.details: Whether it's required when registering patients.

steps.title: Duplicate contacts
steps.details: Whether the same phone or email is allowed on two patients (families). Affects WhatsApp and the portal.

steps.title: Alert emails
steps.details: Whether alerts send their email to the patient on their own.

steps.title: Guided assistant
steps.details: Mascot visible or only the help icon.

steps.title: Save
steps.details: Changes don't apply until you save.
